overall_assessment: Extraction works well for ordinary pages (random controls are complete, clean and well structured). Two real problems: spring offerings are mapped to the plan of the academic year that starts that autumn (wrong year), and about 11 of 15 suspects are English-only stub pages with no plan text (the plan lives on the English site).

findings.description: Every spring (Vår) offering in the packet is fetched from a URL with the offering's calendar year, but HVL's URL year is the academic year (autumn start). Spring 2025 therefore gets the 2025/2026 plan (exam dates 08.06.2026 shown on the page), spring 2024 gets 2024/2025, spring 2021 gets 2021/2022. The plan belongs to a different academic year than the offering.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: URL builder in R/add_course_url.R uses the offering year directly for HVL; for spring semesters it should use year-1 (academic year 2024/2025 contains spring 2025).
findings.suggested_fix: For hvl, build the URL with year - 1 for spring offerings (academic year = start year), or derive the year from the page's 'Emneplan for studieåret' label and verify against the offering; re-harvest spring offerings.

findings.evidence: Emnebeskrivelsen finnes kun på engelsk, gå til våre engelske nettsider ved å klikke "English" øverst i menyfeltet.
findings.description: 11 of 15 suspects (all with language ENG) are Norwegian-site stubs that only contain title, credits, programme list and a pointer to the English site. No learning outcomes, content, assessment etc. are extracted, so these offerings have no plan text although a plan exists on the English pages. Flag 'short' is a real problem here, not a false alarm.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Harvest URL is the Norwegian-language page; the English plan is at a different URL (/en/studies/...) that is not fetched.
findings.suggested_fix: Detect the 'finnes kun på engelsk' notice (post_fn or harvest strategy) and re-fetch the English URL for those courses; otherwise mark them as 'no plan' so they are excluded from analyses instead of counted as empty plans.

Mer om hjelpemidler
findings.description: Empty sections are kept as heading plus a lone '-' placeholder (Praksis plans: content, outcomes, prerequisites, teaching, coursework all '-'), and the trailing link label 'Mer om hjelpemidler' is included in every plan. Cosmetic noise; the placeholders make the praksis courses look like they have headed but empty sections.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: selector div.l-body takes the whole block including empty-section placeholders and link text; no cleanup in post_fn.
findings.suggested_fix: In the hvl post_fn, drop lines that are just '-' and the trailing 'Mer om hjelpemidler/Meir om hjelpemiddel' label; the section step should treat '-' as empty.
